reviews.review:
I know my review time is low, but I've already seen most of what this game offers. I really like marble games but unfortunately this one is very stale and repetitive. 

Pros:

- The Fall Guys style races with tons of marbles are with bots, which sounds bad, but I don't think this game could fill a lobby, so at least you can play the game mode still.
- 4 Player local co-op is a great option.
- The actual controls are average. Having a boost and brake is good.
- The game lets you do small skips if you can drop down to a lower part of the track.

Cons:
- The whole experience is ruined by extremely simplistic tracks. Mostly flat road, half pipes, boosts/ramps, and a few random gimmick obstacles here and there. There ARE longer courses, but many of them are like 20 seconds long for some reason (but even the long ones are just like 5 short ones glued together). Because of this, every race feels the same and it gets repetitive VERY fast.
- Overall presentation with the cheap sounding music and constant currency collection makes it feel like a mobile game.

Honestly, if this was a game made by like one or two people, I still count it as a success. Game dev is hard, and they should still push out a Marble Champions 2 with better courses and more polish. The concept is good, the execution just needs work.
